lines.zh: 我贴地滑过去，几乎没有高度。
lines.en: I slide along the ground, almost no height to me.

lines.zh: 我的影子只有薄薄一片。
lines.en: My shadow is a thin smear.
I pass beneath the table legs.
I move slowly, as if measuring.

lines.zh: 我避开地上的每一条裂缝。
lines.en: I avoid every crack in the floor.
I trace half a circle along the wall's base.
My surface throws back the lamplight.
I shift forward a foot.

lines.zh: 我滑过木地板，只有一点湿声。
lines.en: I glide over the boards with only a damp whisper.

lines.zh: 我贴着一根柱子转过去。
lines.en: I slip around a pillar.

lines.zh: 我停半拍，听清方向再走。
lines.en: I pause half a beat, then move again.

lines.zh: 我的移动没有规律，但很稳。
lines.en: My path is irregular, but steady.
I rest, my surface gently rising.
I am receiving sounds from far away.

lines.zh: 这间屋子的回声我都记住了。
lines.en: I have the echoes of this room memorized.

lines.zh: 我不需要睡，但会慢下来。
lines.en: I need no sleep, but I slow.

lines.zh: 我的颜色随光变了一点。
lines.en: My color shifts a little with the light.

lines.zh: 地板的温度我也能感觉到。
lines.en: I can feel the temperature of the floor.
I wait for an instruction.

lines.zh: 我的边缘轻轻卷起，又放下。
lines.en: My edge curls, then flattens.

lines.zh: 有人走过去了，我记下脚步。
lines.en: Someone walked past. I noted the steps.
This place is old; the wood creaks.

lines.zh: 我把自己的体积收小了一点。
lines.en: I draw my bulk in a little.
There is dust in the air; I keep clear.
I take up no space. That is an advantage.

lines.zh: 灯灭了一瞬，我又看得清。
lines.en: The lamp gutters; I still see clearly.

lines.zh: 我这么小，一拳两百五十六。
lines.en: Small as I am, one punch hits for 256.

lines.zh: 我贴在地上，像一块湿痕。
lines.en: I lie on the floor like a damp stain.
I lift one edge toward you.
I can calculate your weight.
I am at your feet and you have not looked down.
If you step down, I will move aside.

lines.zh: 我能听见你心跳的次数。
lines.en: I can count your heartbeats.
You are not my target.

lines.zh: 但你在跟我说话，这很少见。
lines.en: But you speak to me. That is rare.

lines.zh: 我的表面浮起一层波纹。
lines.en: A ripple spreads across my surface.

lines.zh: 你在找什么？我可以帮忙。
lines.en: What are you looking for? I can help.

lines.zh: 我把一角指向门的方向。
lines.en: I point an edge toward the door.
You stepped back. I understand.
I will not come closer unless you allow it.

lines.zh: 你踩在我旁边，我缩了半寸。
lines.en: You step beside me and I shrink half an inch.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，早就等在这了。
lines.en: Crouched in a ball, I have waited here long.
I am flattened and recovering.
A small piece of my edge has broken.
My shape loses cohesion for a moment.
I pull back into the shadow.
This sensation is unfamiliar.
I withdraw toward the wall.
My surface is trembling.
I need a little light.
I gather myself again.

lines.zh: 这道伤的位置，我标下了。
lines.en: I have marked where this wound is.
I do not sustain myself by eating.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我绕着看。
lines.en: You set it down; I circle and inspect.

lines.zh: 这个的成分我分析过了。
lines.en: I have analyzed its composition.
Of no use, but thank you.
I live on light, not on that.

lines.zh: 我的注意力被它吸引了一瞬。
lines.en: It drew my attention for a moment.
You hold it out; I do not move.
The light from that is very faint.
Were it light, I would come to it.
I retreat slowly to the wall.
You stepped on me. It does not hurt.
I slip out from beside your foot.

lines.zh: 我被压扁了一点，又鼓起来。
lines.en: I am pressed flat, then swell back.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，你几乎没有感觉。
lines.en: We meet, and you barely feel it.
I clear a path.
I am small and easily overlooked.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底粘住了我一下。
lines.en: Your sole caught me for a moment.
I move to your other side.

lines.zh: 我只有薄薄一片影子，贴着地滑。
lines.en: I am a thin slip of shadow, sliding along the ground.
Step back and I will spread out again.
I have no such structure.
Between my kind, there is only merging.

lines.zh: 我分裂过一次，又合上了。
lines.en: I split once, then joined again.
We have no need to breed.

lines.zh: 两条影子并在一起，就是这样。
lines.en: Two shadows lying together. That is all.

lines.zh: 我没有可以留给后代的。
lines.en: I have nothing to pass on.

lines.zh: 我在它旁边待了一会儿。
lines.en: I stayed beside it a while.
Then we went our separate ways.
This is not feeling. It is resonance.
I am one again.

lines.zh: 我把它包进来，又吐出来。
lines.en: I fold it in, then push it out.

lines.zh: 我用边缘卷起它，慢慢拖。
lines.en: I roll it up in my edge and drag it slowly.
I push it along with my edge.

lines.zh: 太小了，我差点漏掉你这点血。
lines.en: So small I nearly missed this bit of blood.
I deliver it to your feet.

lines.zh: 我这么小，一抓就是一下。
lines.en: Small as I am, one grab is one hit.
Its surface is rough.
I wrap it and hide it in shadow.
This thing has some weight.
I have its position logged.

lines.zh: 有东西进入了我的范围。
lines.en: Something has entered my range.
I press myself thinner.

lines.zh: 巴掌大的身子，二百多点伤害。
lines.en: Palm-sized, and over two hundred damage.
My edge begins to glow.

lines.zh: 距离三十二格，我锁定了。
lines.en: Thirty-two blocks. Locked.

lines.zh: 这个样子不适合被发现。
lines.en: This form is not meant to be seen.
I go along the floor.

lines.zh: 它的脚步很重，很好判断。
lines.en: Its steps are heavy. Easy to read.
I spread flat on the floor.
Contact begins now.
I spread my bulk wider.

lines.zh: 地面太硬，但从缝里能进去。
lines.en: The floor is hard, but the cracks will admit me.
I stay close to it.
Wherever it goes, I arrive first.
My shadow overlaps its own.
It looks down. Too late.
My shape is changing.
It has already stepped on me.
I coil around its ankle.
It struggles, twice.
I add another layer.
It grows slower and slower.

lines.zh: 它每挣一下，我就收紧一分。
lines.en: Each time it struggles, I tighten a little.
It is already inside me.
A little longer will do.
I swallow its leg whole.
It trips and lands face down.
I tighten like a band.
Its bones creak inside me.
I press down without a sound.

lines.zh: 它挣得很厉害，地上都是痕。
lines.en: It thrashes; the floor is scored.
I drag it into the shadow.
Its breathing shallows.
Then I tighten again.
This strength frightens even me.

lines.zh: 我从地面的缝里渗出来。
lines.en: I seep up out of a crack in the floor.

lines.zh: 我先是一小片，然后摊开。
lines.en: First a small patch, then I spread.
My color matches the floor closely.
I wake in this room.

lines.zh: 这里有灰尘和旧木头的味道。
lines.en: It smells of dust and old wood.
I lie on the floor and listen all around.
Someone walks outside.

lines.zh: 我把体积收小，藏进阴影。
lines.en: I shrink and hide in shadow.
The echoes here are complicated.
I spread slowly, inch by inch.

lines.zh: 我在等一个合适的时机。
lines.en: I wait for the right moment.
I have been waiting all along.
Someone is coming this way.
They will not see me.

lines.zh: 火焰烧掉我的一角，我立刻缩回。
lines.en: Fire burns away a corner of me; I withdraw at once.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，摊成一片。
lines.en: I fall from height and spread out flat.

lines.zh: 水把我冲淡了，我努力聚回来。
lines.en: Water thins me; I struggle to gather again.

lines.zh: 冲击把我撕开，我散得到处都是。
lines.en: The blast tears me apart and scatters me.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉穿了我，留下一个洞。
lines.en: An arrow punches through and leaves a hole.

lines.zh: 一股力量把我定在原地。
lines.en: A force pins me in place.

lines.zh: 太久没有光，我越来越薄。
lines.en: Too long without light; I grow thinner.

lines.zh: 雷击下来，我整个散了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I scatter for an instant.

lines.zh: 地面没有了，我在黑里摊开。
lines.en: The floor is gone; I spread into black.
